factChecks: Founder is Jiro Katayama, not Hajime Asaoka. Avoid describing the current organisation as a one-person production operation.
Current range has five models. No.8 was announced after No.9; model numbers are not a chronological release order.

Model-page prices take precedence over earlier MinebeaMitsumi launch releases. Current Japanese tax-inclusive prices are date-labelled, without currency conversion or a suggestion of immediate availability.
No.7.5 basic case thickness and maximum height are distinguished.
No.8 seconds disc is a 90-second revolution, not a conventional 60-second indication.
No.9 is hour-striking, not a minute repeater. The in-house development uses some Cal.6498 components; do not claim every part is manufactured in-house.
MinebeaMitsumi's No.9 release incorrectly equates 18000 vph with 3Hz. The manufacturer specifies 2.5Hz. The article does not reproduce the erroneous frequency.
No.5 launch press release and current manufacturer page differ in case-back description. The article does not use the obsolete display-back claim.
GPHG No.6 submission and current manufacturer page differ in water-resistance data. Current model-page 3 ATM rating is used.
The brand's 2026-09-01 news item 822 names the GPHG year as 2025 despite the No.8's 2026 introduction. Do not repeat this inconsistent nomination claim.
The instrument photograph is labelled as general brand inspiration, not falsely identified as the actual electricity meter that inspired No.9.
Japanese delivery address and Japan-issued payment card are explicit official-shop eligibility conditions, not inferred from limited availability.
